meta.transmission: 5-speed TorqueFlite (45RFE/545RFE) 2009-2012; 8-speed TorqueFlite 2013-2024: 845RE/8HP45 (V6 3.6L), 8HP70 (Hemi 5.7L V8 and EcoDiesel 3.0L V6)

shiftLock.slot:
5-SPEED (2009-2012 DS, floor console shifter): Small cap beside the gear selector gate on the console. Pry cap off with flathead screwdriver. Insert screwdriver into slot to depress shift interlock. Press brake and move selector to N. NOTE: 2013+ DS trucks transitioned to 8-speed with under-dash release — see above.

8-SPEED (2013+ DS / ALL DT / TRX / CLASSIC): Manual Park Release under the dash. Panel is LEFT of steering column, ABOVE the parking brake release handle. Pry off small plastic cover with flathead screwdriver. Inside: push the locking tab to the RIGHT with a screwdriver, then pull the orange tether strap REARWARD (toward driver seat) until it clicks locked. Vehicle is now in neutral. TC must be in 2WD/2H — see TC note below.
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the shift lock override slot — Cap at side of console shifter base.
Insert a thin key or flathead into the slot.
Press firmly and hold.
Press the brake pedal.
Move the TorqueFlite selector to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.
Battery under hood, driver side — connect jump pack directly.
Once 12V restored: press brake and shift to N normally (if 5-spd console shifter).
8-SPEED / DEAD BATTERY: pry off panel LEFT of steering column above park brake release. Push locking tab RIGHT, pull orange strap REARWARD until it clicks. Truck is now in N.
TRANSFER CASE: must be in 2WD/2H before road towing. Electronic TC: with engine running, shift TC to 2H. Manual TC: floor lever to 2H. IF BATTERY DEAD: jump first — shift TC requires power.
RWD: lift from rear. 4WD: flatbed strongly preferred.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: MANUAL TRANSFER CASE (floor lever): Vehicle must be STOPPED to shift. If lever is stiff, rock vehicle slightly in neutral while applying firm pressure.
ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

alerts.notes: 4WD: transfer case MUST be in 2H before towing on road.

issues.title: eTorque Mild Hybrid — Not Full Hybrid
issues.detail: The eTorque system is a 48V mild hybrid assist. Despite having a small lithium battery, this is NOT a full hybrid. The 12V battery under the hood is used for jumping normally. The eTorque battery is not accessible for jumping and is managed separately by the vehicle.

issues.title: Manual Transfer Case Lever May Be Stiff
issues.detail: The NV271 manual transfer case floor lever on older HD Rams can be extremely stiff, especially if the vehicle has been in 4WD for extended periods. Rock the vehicle gently in neutral while applying firm pressure to the lever. Do not force — damage to the TC shift fork can occur.

issues.title: Very Heavy Vehicle — Equipment Ratings Critical
issues.detail: Ram 2500/3500 curb weight ranges from 6,400–7,200 lbs. A fully loaded 3500 dually can exceed 14,000 lbs GVWR. Verify all wheel-lift and flatbed equipment is rated appropriately. Standard equipment is often under-rated for these trucks.

Pry cap off, insert screwdriver to depress shift interlock solenoid. Press brake and move lever to N. 9-SPEED 948TE (2022+): floor-mounted selector lever with electronic parking brake. Override: small access panel under dash (same as Ram 1500 under-dash MPR) or small cap at base of floor shifter depending on build date. Confirm via owner's manual — procedure changed with 2022 update.

Connect jump pack — under hood.

Insert thin flathead. Apply FIRM sustained pressure for 5-10 seconds.
While holding, press brake and rotate to N.

Restore 12V. Once powered, press brake and shift floor lever to N normally.

issues.detail: The ProMaster City uses a ZF 9HP rotary dial selector. This transmission requires 12V power to shift reliably. Always jump the battery first.

issues.title: ZF 9HP Rotary Selector — Left of Steering Column
issues.detail: The ProMaster City's rotary gear selector is NOT on the center console — it is to the LEFT of the steering column. The ZF 9HP requires 12V power for reliable shifting. Mechanical override requires significant force.
